_readme: PUBLIC-SAFE EXAMPLE ONLY. Every <LANE_ROOT>/<CONTROL_ROOT>/<DATA_ROOT>/<STATE_ROOT>/<ORG_CONFIG_SHA256>/<ROOT_TABLE_SHA256> token is a placeholder, never a real host path or digest.

Every lane_manifest_sha256 below is a deliberately fake all-zero digest. A real deployment pins the actual sha256 of <lane_root>/LANE_MANIFEST.sha256 (the FILE's own bytes, the same value every register-*-task.ps1 pins); the runner refuses the whole chain, exit 5, nothing run, if any step's digest does not match.

The runner (guild_hall/context_engine/ops/night_chain.mjs) is handed this file with --chain-config and its sha256 with --chain-config-sha256; edit the file, re-hash it, and re-run the registrar's dry-run to get a new plan digest.

Order is the point: each step starts only after the previous step's exit code (and, when given, success_rule) said success. on_failure: stop halts the chain there; continue records the failure and moves on.

success_rule reads the NEWEST receipt matching receipt_glob under that step's own receipts_dir whose mtime is strictly after the step's own start (mtime >= start + 1 ms) -- a receipt left over from an earlier run never counts. Steps without a success_rule are judged by exit code alone.
Per-step args are exactly what that lane's own entry point already documents in its usage header; nothing here is interpreted by a shell.

steps.note: One night of voice conversation-list cards, with the pass-2 reconcile + morning-question present step chained inside its own process (--chain-reconcile). Its own 04:00 deadline stays inside its own args, anchored to this chain's own start; the chain-level --deadline is a separate, later bound.
workspace ledgers' daily refresh (per-project ledgers, then the common-folder ledgers, from one org config). Writes daily-<now>.json with status ok|failed into its --receipts.

The mail attribution index builder -- the step that was in no automation chain before this one; its consumer (graph_sync_once below, --mail-attribution) fails closed once the index is older than 36h. This step writes NO receipt of its own -- only the single index file named by --out -- so it is judged by exit code alone (success_rule null). receipts_dir is still required by the schema; it names a state-root folder this step never writes to, reserved so a future version of the builder that does emit a dated receipt has a home without a config change. The chain runner never writes there either.

One estate_graph_sync.mjs pass reading the index the previous step just built (--mail-attribution with no value takes its default alias address). It writes one receipt PER PROJECT under <receipts>/<project>/, hence the two-segment glob; SYNCED and UNCHANGED are both a clean pass. A pass that refuses to start before any project (a stale index, a root table pin mismatch) writes <receipts>/_preflight/<instant>.json with status FAILED and its reason -- the same two-segment glob finds it, so the chain records receipt_found with that path instead of 'no receipt at all'.

PLACEHOLDER, DISABLED. This step does not exist yet: voice cards are not indexed until the knowledge layer's K5 lands. Listed here so the intended final order is visible and the id is reserved; the runner lists it as skipped and never executes it (naming it with --only is refused). entry/lane_root are placeholders that need not exist while enabled is false.
